testCaseName: Verify successful account creation with all valid data
description: End-to-end positive scenario: a new user can successfully register on EventHub by filling all required fields with valid fake data and is redirected to the login or dashboard page.
preconditions: User is on the Sign Up / Create your account page (reached via the Register link on the login page)
Test email is unique and not already registered on the platform

testSteps.action: Navigate to https://eventhub.rahulshettyacademy.com/ and click the 'Register' link from the login page
Verify the Create Account form is displayed with all required fields visible (First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone Number, Password, Confirm Password, and Create Account button)
Enter a valid first name in the First Name field
Enter a valid last name in the Last Name field
Enter a unique, valid fake email address in the Email field
Enter a valid 10-digit phone number in the Phone Number field
Enter a strong password that satisfies all stated rules (uppercase, lowercase, digit, special character, min length)
Re-enter the same password in the Confirm Password field
Click the 'Create Account' / 'Sign Up' button
Wait for the form submission to complete and observe the response
Verify a success message is displayed (e.g., 'Account created successfully') and the user is redirected to the login page or auto-logged into the dashboard

expectedResult: The user is successfully registered on EventHub. A success confirmation message is displayed and the user is either redirected to the login page (with a 'registered successfully' notice) or automatically signed in to the dashboard.

testCaseName: Verify 'Register' link is accessible from the login page
description: Navigation/UI test: a new user must be able to discover the signup flow from the existing login page via the 'Register' link.
preconditions: User is on the login page

testSteps.action: Navigate to https://eventhub.rahulshettyacademy.com/ and wait for the login form to render
Look for a 'Register' link on the login page (text 'Don't have an account? Register')
Click the 'Register' link
Verify the URL changes to a signup route (e.g., /register or /sign-up) and the Create Account form is displayed

expectedResult: The 'Register' link is clearly visible on the login page. Clicking it navigates the user to the Create Account / Sign Up form.

testCaseName: Verify password and confirm password mismatch is rejected
description: Negative field validation: when Password and Confirm Password values do not match, the form must surface a mismatch error and block submission.
preconditions: User is on the Create Account page

testSteps.action: Fill all fields with valid data but enter different values in Password and Confirm Password
testSteps.testData: First Name: TestFirst, Last Name: TestLast, Email: testuser2026@example.com, Phone: 9876543210, Password: Test@123456, Confirm Password: Test@654321

testSteps.action: Click the 'Create Account' button
Verify the Confirm Password field shows a 'Passwords do not match' (or equivalent) error and the form is not submitted

expectedResult: A password-mismatch error is displayed for the Confirm Password field. The form is not submitted and no account is created.

testCaseName: Verify registering with an already-used email is rejected
description: Negative/duplicate scenario: attempting to register with an email that already exists in the system must surface a duplicate-email error.
preconditions: User is on the Create Account page
An account with email 'ginni@gmail.com' already exists on the platform (the demo account configured in testD.config.json)

testSteps.action: Fill the form with a unique name/phone and a strong password, but use an email that is already registered
testSteps.testData: First Name: TestFirst, Last Name: TestLast, Email: ginni@gmail.com, Phone: 9876543210, Password: Test@123456, Confirm Password: Test@123456

testSteps.action: Click the 'Create Account' button
Observe the response and any error message
Verify a 'User with this email already exists' (or equivalent) error is shown and no new account is created

expectedResult: The form is not successfully submitted. A duplicate-email error is shown to the user. The existing account is unaffected and no new account is created.

testCaseName: Verify invalid email format is rejected
description: Negative field validation: malformed email addresses must be rejected before the API call is made.
preconditions: User is on the Create Account page

testSteps.action: Fill all fields with valid data but enter an invalid email format (missing @)
testSteps.testData: First Name: TestFirst, Last Name: TestLast, Email: testuser2026.example.com, Phone: 9876543210, Password: Test@123456, Confirm Password: Test@123456

testSteps.action: Click the 'Create Account' button
Verify the Email field shows a 'Please enter a valid email address' (or equivalent) error and the form is not submitted

expectedResult: The Email field is highlighted as invalid. The form does not submit and no account is created.
